telecomms_dish.notes: Shared receiver/broadcaster geometry, receiver/transmitter/off states; open receiving dish and original colored signal-strut texels. broadcaster_send beam is a runtime effect at Signal_Origin, not a solid obstruction.

telecomms_processor.notes: Source processor/processor_off with separate service flap and source open wiring. Raised processor screen and vented lower chassis.

telecomms_bus_ntnet.notes: Source bus/bus_off with separate service flap and source open wiring. NTNet uses bus/bus_off exactly; same geometry, no duplicate relay model.

telecomms_hub.notes: Tall five-row telecomms hub with source on/off panels and side service flap. One tile; no separate per-direction models.

telecomms_server.notes: Shared chassis proportions, original comm_server atlas; source status variants and service wiring. Research master-server theft stages are not part of the ordinary server type; no objective stripes baked in.

research_server.notes: Shared chassis proportions, original RD-server-on atlas; source status variants and service wiring. Research master-server theft stages are not part of the ordinary server type; no objective stripes baked in.

announcement_system.notes: Separate tower, red cabling and terminal, on/off screen and original independently controlled arrival/head/error indicators. EMP and configuration dispatch remain gameplay.

blackbox_recorder.notes: Two independent rotating reels and removable blackbox block, recording/empty clips. Source removal stops tapes. Runtime item ownership/transfer is separate.
